milestones.note: The 2026 drawing ran from 4 February. The hour is not stored.

milestones.label: Drawing closes
milestones.note: The 2026 drawing closed on 25 February.

milestones.label: Drawing results
milestones.note: Results were released on 4 March 2026.

milestones.label: Ballot opens
milestones.note: Opened at 09:00 British Summer Time on Friday 24 April 2026.

milestones.label: Ballot closes
milestones.note: Closed at 16:00 British Summer Time on Friday 1 May 2026.

milestones.label: Ballot opens
milestones.note: The 2027 ballot opened on 10 June 2026. The hour is not stored.

milestones.label: Ballot closes
milestones.note: The 2027 ballot closed on 24 June 2026. The hour is not stored.

milestones.label: Race fee charged
milestones.note: The race fee is charged when the result is issued, not as a later invoice. The application fee was ZAR 5.

milestones.label: Ballot results
milestones.note: Results were notified on 26 June 2026.

milestones.label: Selected field
milestones.note: The organiser announced the selected list on 30 June 2026. China does not use daylight saving.

milestones.label: Ballot results
milestones.note: Results were emailed through Thursday 9 July 2026. The organiser asked applicants to get in touch if nothing had arrived by 09:00 on Friday 10 July.

milestones.label: Confirm entry
milestones.note: Successful applicants had to confirm details, and pay any balance, by 16:00 British Summer Time on Friday 31 July 2026.

milestones.label: Lottery opens
milestones.note: General entry opened at 11:00 Japan time on Friday 14 August 2026.

milestones.label: Lottery closes
milestones.note: General entry closed at 17:00 Japan time on Friday 28 August 2026.

milestones.label: Registration opens
milestones.note: Qualifier registration week opened on Monday 14 September 2026. The opening hour is not stored.

milestones.label: Lottery results
milestones.note: General entry results were notified on 18 September 2026. The hour is not stored.

milestones.label: Registration closes
milestones.note: Registration closed at 17:00 Eastern on Friday 18 September 2026.

milestones.label: Ballot opens
milestones.note: Opened on 29 September 2026. That morning was still Australian Eastern Standard Time. The opening hour is not stored.

milestones.label: Payment
milestones.note: The fee is charged as acceptances go out. There is not a separate public payment deadline.

milestones.label: Acceptances
milestones.note: The B.A.A. began sending acceptances on 29 September 2026. 25,630 qualifiers were accepted. The cutoff was 5:17 inside the standard.

milestones.label: Payment due
milestones.note: Selected runners had to pay by 30 September 2026. Confirm the cutoff if you still have an unpaid place.

milestones.label: Lottery opens
milestones.note: The 2027 lottery opened on 1 October 2026. The opening hour is not stored. Central European Summer Time was still in effect.

milestones.label: Good for Age opens
milestones.note: UK residents with a qualifying time. The window opened on 1 October 2026. The opening hour is not stored. About 6,000 places, fastest first, so the standard alone does not guarantee a place.

milestones.label: Applications open
milestones.note: Guaranteed and non-guaranteed applications opened at 08:00 US Central on Thursday 8 October 2026.

milestones.label: Ballot closes
milestones.note: Closed at 10:00 Australian Eastern Daylight Time on Monday 19 October 2026, which is 23:00 UTC on 18 October.

milestones.label: Expo
milestones.note: Javits Center, 11th Avenue between West 35th and 36th. Thursday 29 October 10:00–20:00 (bibs until 19:30), Friday 30 October 10:00–20:00 (bibs until 19:30), Saturday 31 October 09:00–17:00 (bibs until 16:30). No proxy pickup.

milestones.label: Good for Age closes
milestones.note: Closes at 16:00 UK time on Thursday 29 October 2026. Clocks have gone back, so this is GMT.

milestones.label: Applications close
milestones.note: Applications close at 14:00 US Central on Thursday 29 October 2026.

milestones.label: Race day
milestones.note: Sunday 1 November 2026. US clocks go back at 02:00 that morning, so midnight is still Eastern Daylight Time and the evening is Eastern Standard Time. The countdown uses the calendar day, not a wave start.

milestones.label: Fee charged if drawn
milestones.note: The entry fee is charged automatically on the result. There is no later public payment deadline.

milestones.label: Ballot results
milestones.note: Applicants are told on 3 November 2026. The hour is not published.

milestones.label: Guaranteed entry payment
milestones.note: Approved guaranteed-entry applicants must pay by 23:59 US Central on Tuesday 10 November 2026. Central Standard Time is in effect.

milestones.label: Lottery closes
milestones.note: The lottery closes on Thursday 12 November 2026. The organiser's published cutoff for deferred-entry codes that day is 23:59 CET. Confirm the form's own hour if you apply on the last day.

milestones.label: Lottery results
milestones.note: Results are emailed on Thursday 3 December 2026. The hour is not published.

milestones.label: Payment processing
milestones.note: If you are selected, the entry fee is processed from 4 December 2026. The organiser says the bank can take up to a week.

milestones.label: Race day
milestones.note: Sunday 6 December 2026, the second Abbott World Marathon Majors evaluation race. Not yet a Major.

milestones.label: Drawing results
milestones.note: Non-guaranteed applicants are emailed through Tuesday 8 December 2026. There is not a single send time.

milestones.label: Drawing payment
milestones.note: Runners selected in the drawing must pay and finish registration by 23:59 US Central on Tuesday 15 December 2026.

milestones.label: Race day
milestones.note: Sunday 7 March 2027. The countdown uses the calendar day in Tokyo, not a wave start.

milestones.label: Race day
milestones.note: Monday 19 April 2027, Patriots' Day. The countdown uses the calendar day, not a wave start.

milestones.label: Race weekend
milestones.note: Saturday 24 April and Sunday 25 April 2027. Your confirmation says which day you have. The countdown starts at the beginning of Saturday in London.

milestones.label: Race day
milestones.note: Sunday 23 May 2027. First edition as a World Marathon Major. South Africa does not use daylight saving.

milestones.label: Race day
milestones.note: Sunday 29 August 2027. August is Australian Eastern Standard Time. The countdown uses the calendar day, not a wave start.

milestones.label: Race day
milestones.note: Sunday 26 September 2027. The countdown uses the calendar day in Berlin, not a wave start.

milestones.label: Expo
milestones.note: Abbott Health & Fitness Expo at McCormick Place. Thursday 7 October 2027 10:00–18:00, Friday 8 October 09:00–18:00, Saturday 9 October 09:00–18:00 Central. Hours can change. No race-morning pickup. Photo ID is required.

milestones.label: Race day
milestones.note: Sunday 10 October 2027. The countdown uses the calendar day in Chicago, not a wave start.

milestones.label: Race day
milestones.note: Sunday 7 November 2027. US clocks go back at 02:00 that morning. The countdown uses the calendar day, not a wave start. The drawing dates are still unpublished.
